projectDescription: A codelab demonstrating how to use Gemini File Search to enable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in agentic applications built with the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), without managing embeddings or vector databases.
keyFeatures: Managed RAG with no vector database setup required
Gemini File Search Store for document ingestion and indexing
Agent-as-a-Tool pattern for combining Google Search and File Search
Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) multi-agent orchestration
Jupyter notebook for managing File Search Stores
Support for PDF, DOCX, Markdown, CSV, JSON and many more document types
Custom metadata tagging for uploaded files
ADK Web UI for interactive agent testing
publicApiSurface: make install / make sdk-agent / make sdk-rag-agent / make adk-playground
